_about: Jena's app list for .github/workflows/jena-apps.yml. Each entry is built from source, downloaded from its official release, or (Windows-only programs) run on a windows-latest runner with its output sent back. The box installer (/home/jena/jena-apps/installer.py) dispatches the workflow with an app name only; the commands live here, never in the dispatch. Linux builds run in debian:bookworm so the binaries match Jena's box (glibc 2.36).

st.title: st terminal
st.about: suckless simple terminal: a tiny real X11 terminal for Jena's desktop

btop.title: btop
btop.about: resource monitor (official static release), opens in a terminal

du-windows.title: Sysinternals Disk Usage (Windows)
du-windows.about: Windows-only Sysinternals du64.exe, run headless on a windows-latest runner; its output comes back to Jena

steam.title: Steam
steam.disabled_reason: waits for the bigger-disk box (todo 54e3b0): Steam needs ~1.5 GB+ after its first self-update and the box keeps 1 GB free
steam.i386_notes: Steam's runtime is 32-bit: on the box (root, once) run `dpkg --add-architecture i386 && apt-get update && apt-get install -y libc6:i386 libgl1:i386 libgl1-mesa-dri:i386 libx11-6:i386 libxrandr2:i386 libxinerama1:i386 libasound2:i386 libpulse0:i386 libnss3:i386 libfreetype6:i386 libdbus-1-3:i386` and install the .deb with apt (it pulls steam-libs-i386). The installer extracts debs without root, so for Steam it only stages the .deb and records these steps; sign-in stays mama's (never automated).
